name: FA_MC_BOOK_CONTROLS
description: FA_MC_BOOK_CONTROLS table contains control information that affects all assets in a reporting depreciation book. The BOOK_TYPE_CODE in FA_MC_BOOK_CONTROLS is the same as the BOOK_TYPE_CODE in the parent record in FA_ BOOK_CONTROLS. It is a multiple reporting currency subtable of FA_ BOOK_CONTROLS.

columns.name: SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the accounting ledger.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency that is used on the page.

columns.name: DEPRN_STATUS
columns.description: Depreciation program status. Possible values are C for completed, E for error, R for running, and S for submitted.

columns.name: DEPRN_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the last depreciation job that last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Last period depreciated in the book.

columns.name: LAST_DEPRN_RUN_DATE
columns.description: Date of the last depreciation run.

columns.name: CURRENT_FISCAL_YEAR
columns.description: Current fiscal year for the book.

columns.name: RETIRED_STATUS
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: RETIRED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: PRIMARY_SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the primary ledger associated with the reporting ledger for this row.

columns.name: PRIMARY_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code of the primary ledger.

columns.name: SOURCE_RETIRED_STATUS
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: SOURCE_RETIRED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: MRC_CONVERTED_FLAG
columns.description: Option to indicate whether the set of books is converted to Multiple Reporting Currencies options.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether this reporting currency and book association is active.

columns.name: NBV_AMOUNT_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Depreciation rounding threshold amount based on currency and precision.

columns.name: CONVERSION_STATUS
columns.description: Status indicating whether the reporting book has been converted or not.

columns.name: MASS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of a pending or in process mass transaction job that last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: GL_POSTING_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the accounting entries can be posted to General Ledger.
